A '''Hapan Battle Dragon''' was used as the base of operations for the [[Jedi Coalition]] [[Second Battle of Roche|mission]] that was dispatched to the [[Roche system]] in [[41 ABY]]. While the [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] was in the [[Transitory Mists]], the operation was launched from its [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]].
